# This file is automatically generated from cmake.toml - DO NOT EDIT
# See https://github.com/build-cpp/cmkr for more information

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include("cmkr.cmake" OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	configure_file(cmake.toml cmake.toml COPYONLY)
endif()

project(emu
	LANGUAGES
		CXX
)

# Package manager
include(FetchContent)

message(STATUS "Fetching capstone (v5)...")
FetchContent_Declare(
	capstone
	GIT_REPOSITORY "https://github.com/capstone-engine/capstone"
	GIT_TAG v5
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(capstone)

# Target emu-tests
set(CMKR_TARGET emu-tests)
set(emu-tests_SOURCES "")

file(GLOB_RECURSE CMKR_GLOB_emu-tests_src CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "src/*.hpp" "src/*.cpp")

list(APPEND emu-tests_SOURCES
	"tests/main.cpp"
)

list(APPEND emu-tests_SOURCES
	${CMKR_GLOB_emu-tests_src}
)

list(APPEND emu-tests_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
)

set(CMKR_SOURCES ${emu-tests_SOURCES})
add_executable(emu-tests)

if(emu-tests_SOURCES)
	target_sources(emu-tests PRIVATE ${emu-tests_SOURCES})
endif()

get_directory_property(CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} DEFINE_PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
if(NOT CMKR_VS_STARTUP_PROJECT)
	set_property(DIRECTORY ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR} PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT emu-tests)
endif()

source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${emu-tests_SOURCES})

target_compile_features(emu-tests PRIVATE
	cxx_std_20
)

target_include_directories(emu-tests PRIVATE
	"src"
)

target_link_libraries(emu-tests PRIVATE
	capstone_static
)

unset(CMKR_TARGET)
unset(CMKR_SOURCES)
